title: calonema radiale

It has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. However, further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of this plant.
